requirements.title: Authority is explicit and one-way
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every listed artifact has exactly one authority and conformance is derived exclusively from normative artifacts.

requirements.title: Version identity is stable
requirements.acceptance_gate: Series, release version, lifecycle state, validator version, normative digest, and conformance-pack digest are explicit and version-bound.

requirements.title: Released content is immutable
requirements.acceptance_gate: In-place release mutation and downgrade are denied; a change requires a strictly greater version, new path, and unchanged observed source digest.

requirements.title: Requirement identifiers are unique and permanent
requirements.acceptance_gate: Requirement identifiers match the shared stable format; amendments compare bound catalogs and exactly mark changed and new identifiers without removal or reassignment.

requirements.title: Vocabulary is canonical
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every named canonical term resolves to CONTEXT.md and no avoided synonym is accepted.

requirements.title: Structured contracts are closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: Draft 2020-12 schemas reject unknown fields, enforce identifier and digest boundaries, and terminate within explicit evaluation and error budgets.

requirements.title: Lifecycle tables are complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Each state-command pair occurs exactly once with all required transition fields and denied-row coverage.

requirements.title: Traceability is stable and total
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every normative requirement has one resolving traceability record and every reference resolves.

requirements.title: Conformance observes public effects
requirements.acceptance_gate: Required fixtures bind observable lifecycle state and command evidence, while release assets bind specification and conformance-pack digests, validator version, independently reproduced validation, and traceability reports.

requirements.title: Package layout is declared
requirements.acceptance_gate: The manifest declares every final release slot and distinguishes candidate foundation contents.

requirements.title: Release authority is non-ambiguous
requirements.acceptance_gate: Vault-owner and independent-technical approvals bind one digest to different canonical authenticated human principals and cannot be inferred or substituted.

requirements.title: The package is specification-only
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only declared specification artifacts and the exact conformance executable inventory exist; no production boundary is implemented or invoked.

requirements.title: Validator extensions are closed and version-bound
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only registered extension identifiers and their exact version-bound subject schemas are evaluated; ambient or undeclared validators are denied.

requirements.title: Every validation artifact shares one immutable version binding
requirements.acceptance_gate: Invocations, envelopes, claims, artifacts, receipts, recovery reports, and verdicts bind the current package and validator versions and recomputed artifact digests.

requirements.title: Evidence envelopes are deterministic and complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every envelope explicitly carries its requirement, subject, ordered digests and verified receipt bindings, execution context, and verdict with contiguous ordinals.

requirements.title: Claim manifests bind one claim to required evidence
requirements.acceptance_gate: Each of the eight isolated profiles has one closed manifest and independent digest binding from claim and requirement to evidence and verdict.

requirements.title: Verdict aggregation denies absent mandatory proof
requirements.acceptance_gate: Pass requires complete current mandatory proof; fail, unsupported, and inconclusive retain distinct non-pass semantics under the complete verdict table.

requirements.title: Readback and recovery preserve non-pass results
requirements.acceptance_gate: Readback recomputes every binding and fail, unsupported, or inconclusive remains effective until fresh mandatory evidence reopens evaluation through the complete lifecycle.

requirements.title: Validator evidence artifacts are specification-only
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only specification, schemas, fixtures, validator assertions, traceability, and evidence artifacts are added; no production mdplace boundary is implemented or invoked.

requirements.title: The canonical operation envelope is closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: Stable REQ-SK identifiers and canonical vocabulary define every accepted append and replay record as one digest-bound immutable OperationCommit with identity, version, exact authority, bases, ordering, typed independently versioned events, idempotency, preconditions, and closure receipt; malformed, torn, noncanonical, unsupported, unknown, and digest-mismatched records are rejected atomically.

requirements.title: Compare-and-append is serialized and fail-closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: A closed scenario and operation schema, package-bound exact-tuple capability registry, and complete lifecycle table ensure an authorized exact-base command with a recomputed command digest, unique idempotency material, and a new operation identity against complete history emits one immutable canonical operation and receipt; stale, duplicate, incompatible, unauthorized, noncontiguous, failed-precondition, or illegal input emits one deterministic rejection and no semantic write.

requirements.title: Replay snapshots ordering and views are deterministic
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 30 manifest scenarios prove atomic ordered-event replay, operation fixity, legal and illegal removal, full replay and valid-snapshot suffix equivalence, stable ordering, recognized forward-compatible no-op behavior, and disposable view rebuild only from canonical history.

requirements.title: Stateful fixtures observe complete closure outcomes
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 30 manifest-owned stateful scenarios are classified by ID, path, subject kind, or schema with all four paired, cover every required class including removal, and expose accepted or rejected closure, canonical record or none, receipts, semantic state, snapshots or replay, rebuilt views, filesystem effects, terminal state, and illegal transitions.

requirements.title: Validation and evidence bind public behavior
requirements.acceptance_gate: The validator checks public schemas, closed receipts, lifecycle behavior, ordering, idempotency, replay, snapshots, rebuild, recovery, authority denials, traceability, and fixture/result-bound machine evidence without private implementation assertions.

requirements.title: The accepted reconciliation remains an input
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every Semantic Kernel requirement binds the exact accepted issue #2 decision as input_without_reopening and none restores a deprecated authority or persistence model.

requirements.title: Artifacts are specification and conformance only
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only specification, schemas, registries, fixtures, conformance-only observers, traceability, and evidence are added; no production mdplace boundary or vault mutation is implemented or invoked.

requirements.title: Operational state never establishes semantic truth
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every control-plane document declares no semantic authority, attempted operational semantic writes are denied, and every stateful scenario exposes the unchanged Semantic Kernel state digest.

requirements.title: Work Journal and Scheduler records are closed durable and bounded
requirements.acceptance_gate: Closed Work Journal and Scheduler documents enforce exact identities, versions, digests, dependencies, ownership, receipts, concurrency, child-process, attempt, retry, wall-time, output, lease, and recovery budgets; dequeue acknowledgement follows a durable Work Lease receipt.

requirements.title: Queue retry cancellation and resume are version-bound
requirements.acceptance_gate: Complete queue, retry, and cancellation matrices and stateful fixtures prove exact-version ownership, retry ceilings, durable cancellation, bounded owner-authorized resume, idempotent enqueue, and deterministic stale or illegal rejection.

requirements.title: One persistent mdplace Agent becomes ready in strict order
requirements.acceptance_gate: Closed Agent state, supervision profile, and complete Agent, readiness, writer, channel, and LaunchAgent supervision matrices prove six ordered readiness gates, diagnostic-only blocked access, bounded restart backoff, wake lock/filesystem/drift revalidation, a durable persistent circuit breaker, exact owner-approved recovery, retained exclusive ownership, and denial of a competing Agent.

requirements.title: The Control Channel is local authenticated bounded and stale-safe
requirements.acceptance_gate: A closed Control Command and complete Control Channel matrix enforce Unix-domain transport, diagnostic-only versus work-admitting modes, same-user peer credentials, vault scope, protocol and base versions, size, time, response, and concurrency limits; blocked status and doctor remain observable while every work-taking command remains denied and no downstream authority is granted.

requirements.title: Child work is isolated and disposable
requirements.acceptance_gate: Fixtures and recovery evidence terminate child failure or attempted authority use, accept only schema-valid non-authoritative output with a completion receipt, and expose no vault, shell, arbitrary network, semantic-writer, or mutation capability.

requirements.title: Work Recovery is default-deny and receipt-driven
requirements.acceptance_gate: The closed recovery matrix and digest-bound reports prove committed enqueue, leased and in-flight recovery, terminal non-repetition, durable cancellation, repeated-interruption bounds, unknown-completion blocking, bounded supervisor recovery, durable doctor evidence, exact owner recovery approval, and exact receipt and base validation.

requirements.title: Exactly twenty-five stateful scenarios prove the public boundary
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 25 manifest-owned CP-001 through CP-025 scenarios cover every required positive, negative, boundary, stale, authority, illegal, cancellation, restart, resume, and crash/recovery behavior through public inputs, outputs, operations, receipts, filesystem effects, terminal state, and illegal-transition status.

requirements.title: Accepted component and lifecycle decisions remain inputs
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every control-plane requirement traces to both accepted decisions as input_without_reopening and preserves their one-Agent, local diagnostic/work-admission Control Channel, isolated-child, bounded LaunchAgent backoff, wake revalidation, persistent circuit breaker, doctor-guided owner recovery, startup, and writer boundaries.

requirements.title: This package contains no production control plane
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only specification and conformance artifacts are present; validation opens no socket, starts no Agent or Child Work Invocation, acquires no vault lock, appends no semantic operation, and mutates no vault.

requirements.title: Stable requirements use canonical policy vocabulary
requirements.acceptance_gate: Stable REQ-CPP identifiers use only canonical vocabulary and distinguish Processing Policy permission, Source Profile approval, compatibility evidence, and semantic authority.

requirements.title: Processing Policy and Source Profile contracts are closed and complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Closed policy, Source Profile, request, rule, receipt, scenario, lifecycle, and recovery contracts enumerate every version, grant, obligation, binding, authority, transition, and failure without ambient defaults.

requirements.title: Every ungranted or stale request is denied before effect
requirements.acceptance_gate: All absent, unknown, unpermitted, over-budget, over-retry, over-fallback, unredacted, retention-unproven, stale, hostile, or authority-widening requests deny before transmission, semantic operation, or filesystem effect.

requirements.title: Descendant policies narrow monotonically
requirements.acceptance_gate: Canary and policy-pair fixtures prove exact parent binding, preservation or reduction of every permission dimension, and deterministic denial of each attempted widening.

requirements.title: Source Profile approval and readback precede intake
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every intake decision follows nondelegated vault-owner approval and exact digest readback of all Source Profile bindings; absent, stale, mismatched, revoked, or compatibility-claim-substituted binding denies intake.

requirements.title: Fixtures and machine evidence prove public closure
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 50 fixture and result digest bindings prove public inputs, decisions, receipts, filesystem effects, boundaries, stale states, policy pairs, illegal transitions, and recovery without private assertions.

requirements.title: Issue number 8 is not reopened and no production code is added
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every REQ-CPP record cites only the exact accepted issue #8 resolution as input_without_reopening and all additions remain specification and conformance artifacts with zero production or vault effects.

requirements.title: Stable requirements use canonical mutation vocabulary
requirements.acceptance_gate: Stable REQ-VMG identifiers and all contract artifacts use the canonical mutation vocabulary.

requirements.title: The Authorized Mutation Plan is closed and exact
requirements.acceptance_gate: The closed Authorized Mutation Plan rejects every missing, unknown, stale, undeclared, unauthorized, unsafe, colliding, or incompatible binding before unsafe mutation.

requirements.title: Every authoritative read is descriptor-relative and same-handle
requirements.acceptance_gate: The executable probe begins from a trusted-root descriptor, uses openat with O_NOFOLLOW for every component, hashes through the same handle, reruns fstat, and never reopens a validated pathname as authority.

requirements.title: Preconditions receipt echo and readback bind identical identity
requirements.acceptance_gate: The precondition, Operation Receipt echo, and retained-descriptor readback bind the identical device, inode, size, and hash tuple; every mismatch is non-success.

requirements.title: Exclusive ownership and durability precede effects
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exclusive ownership and the complete journal, data, metadata, receipt, echo, readback, and commit sync order are validator-enforced before success.

requirements.title: Mutation lifecycle and idempotency are complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: The complete state-command matrix covers every legal and illegal transition, and compatible retries never duplicate an effect.

requirements.title: Recovery is deterministic at every crash boundary
requirements.acceptance_gate: All sixteen before/after crash boundaries and four interruption modes deterministically resume, roll back, compensate, or halt in Terminal Manual Repair.

requirements.title: Public fixtures prove safe and unsafe boundaries
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 88 public fixtures include 64 boundary-mode cases plus named success, denial, exact, stale, authority, illegal-transition, and recovery cases with no unsafe filesystem effect.

requirements.title: Traceability and machine evidence are complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every requirement binds both accepted decisions, contract artifacts, positive and negative fixtures, acceptance gates, and digest-bound machine recovery evidence.

requirements.title: Accepted decisions remain inputs and artifacts remain non-production
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every requirement preserves issue #7 and issue #26 as input_without_reopening, while every added artifact remains specification or conformance material and performs no real vault mutation.

requirements.title: Stable requirements use canonical protocol vocabulary
requirements.acceptance_gate: All eight stable requirement identifiers and canonical protocol terms resolve without aliases or conflicting meanings.

requirements.title: Processing Envelope proposal and receipt contracts are closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every structured protocol artifact validates against a closed schema and binds the exact approved versions and transmitted facts.

requirements.title: Policy binding isolation and canary checks precede transmission
requirements.acceptance_gate: Any stale authorization, widening, isolation defect, or failed canary records a deterministic denial and transmits zero bytes.

requirements.title: Every initial retry and fallback attempt is independently bounded
requirements.acceptance_gate: All seven complete lifecycle tables and instrumented budgets deny any unbound retry, fallback, timeout, or ceiling excess.

requirements.title: Returned output is inert and adapters have zero authority
requirements.acceptance_gate: Output remains inert through closed validation and no valid or invalid proposal creates semantic, tool, or filesystem effects.

requirements.title: Outcomes and recovery have deterministic receipts
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every terminal, retry, fallback, timeout, denial, malformed, budget, isolation, and recovery outcome has one recomputable receipt.

requirements.title: Public fixtures and evidence prove the protocol
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 42 public fixtures and digest-bound instrumented, isolation, canary, and recovery evidence cover every required observable boundary.

requirements.title: Decision and specification boundaries remain closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: Decision DEC-008 is the sole input, no product or adapter-profile claim changes, and every added artifact remains specification or conformance material.

requirements.title: Canonical corpus vocabulary and scope are fixed
requirements.acceptance_gate: Stable REQ-RVG identifiers use only canonical corpus vocabulary and define specification and conformance artifacts without production behavior.

requirements.title: Corpus partitions and lineage groups are immutable
requirements.acceptance_gate: Train, calibration, and test membership digests are immutable, every lineage belongs to exactly one partition, and redistribution moves only a whole lineage within that partition.

requirements.title: The scale manifest fixes every Reference Vault boundary
requirements.acceptance_gate: The closed Scale Manifest fixes exactly 25,000 notes, 100,000 versions, 1,000 categories, 1,000,000 events, 1,000 queued candidates, and a 5 MiB candidate limit with deferred localized images excluded.

requirements.title: Seed and generator version bind deterministic output
requirements.acceptance_gate: The exact generator identity, version, algorithm, and seed digest produce digest-identical manifests, while duplicate, conflicting, or stale bindings are rejected.

requirements.title: Coverage accounting is total and unique
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every fixed count is accounted exactly once by partition sums or one global exact account; omissions and duplicates fail conformance.

requirements.title: Redistribution preserves partition and lineage identity
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only idempotent retries and whole-lineage moves between shards in the same current partition are allowed; every cross-partition, partial, stale, or coverage-changing request is denied.

requirements.title: Generation redistribution and recovery lifecycles are complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Generation, redistribution, and recovery tables cover every declared step and state-command pair with exact authority, outputs, receipts, effects, failure, idempotency, and recovery.

requirements.title: Boundary fixtures reject every invalid scale and identity case
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 35 public fixtures cover every fixed boundary plus determinism, identity, unique coverage, sealed membership, redistribution, stale state, authority, allowed and denied lifecycle behavior, crash, and artifact-bound recovery.

requirements.title: Recovery evidence is deterministic and observable
requirements.acceptance_gate: The recovery report binds identical seeded digests, all fixtures, isolation receipts, lifecycle digests, recovery outcomes, and zero filesystem effects.

requirements.title: Traceability is complete and materialization remains deferred
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every REQ-RVG record binds issue #10 as input_without_reopening and all artifacts remain specification/conformance-only with materialization and performance claims deferred.
